name: Inside Leg Hang 1
description: An inverted hang on your inside leg with no hands on the pole. A first step into trusting your leg grip.

criteria.label: Contact
criteria.text: Inside leg and side of torso. Optional: foot of inside leg, back of inside arm, shoulder blade

criteria.label: Arms
criteria.text: Fixed position of your choice, no hands on the pole

criteria.label: Legs
criteria.text: Stag position

criteria.label: Body
criteria.text: Inverted

criteria.label: Split
criteria.text: At least 160°, with 20° tolerance

criteria.label: Hold
criteria.text: At least 2 seconds

name: Front Split 1
description: An upright front split on the pole, holding on with the grip of your choice.

criteria.label: Contact
criteria.text: Legs and hands. Optional: forearms, feet

criteria.label: Arms
criteria.text: Grip of your choice

criteria.label: Legs
criteria.text: Both legs extended in a front split

criteria.label: Body
criteria.text: Upright

criteria.label: Split
criteria.text: At least 160°

criteria.label: Hold
criteria.text: At least 2 seconds

name: Allegra Split 1
description: A frontal split with your back to the pole. Your inside hand grips the pole above your inside leg, your back arches away from the pole, and your outside arm reaches out while both legs open wide.

criteria.label: Grip
criteria.text: Inside hand grips the pole above the inside leg; outside arm extended in a fixed position of your choice

criteria.label: Contact
criteria.text: Hand of the inside arm, thigh of the inside leg, side of torso or lower back

criteria.label: Legs
criteria.text: Frontal split, both legs fully extended

criteria.label: Body
criteria.text: Back arched, facing away from the pole

criteria.label: Angle
criteria.text: Split of at least 160°

criteria.label: Hold
criteria.text: At least 2 seconds

name: Bridge
description: An inverted backbend held in your hands. Grip the pole with straight arms, arch your back and lift your hips and closed legs until they are parallel to the floor.

criteria.label: Grip
criteria.text: Grip of your choice, arms fully extended

criteria.label: Contact
criteria.text: Both hands, inner thighs

criteria.label: Legs
criteria.text: Both legs extended and closed

criteria.label: Body
criteria.text: Inverted, back arched, hips and both legs parallel to the floor

criteria.label: Hold
criteria.text: At least 2 seconds

name: Lux
description: A back-arched hold in split grip. Both arms stay straight, one leg and your hips touch the pole, and your upper body arches back with your head level with or above your hips.

criteria.label: Grip
criteria.text: Split grip

criteria.label: Arms
criteria.text: Both arms fully extended

criteria.label: Contact
criteria.text: Both hands, one leg and hips

criteria.label: Legs
criteria.text: Position of your choice, on the same side of the pole as your body

criteria.label: Body
criteria.text: Upper body in a back arch, head at the same level as the hips or higher

criteria.label: Hold
criteria.text: At least 2 seconds

name: Handstand Hip Hold Split
description: A one-handed back bend at the foot of the pole. Your outside hand is on the floor, your inside hand holds your inside leg at the shin, and your legs open into a full split with the inside foot on the floor.

criteria.label: Contact
criteria.text: Side of torso, outside ankle, back of inside shoulder

criteria.label: Arms
criteria.text: Both arms fully extended. Inside hand holds the inside leg at the shin, between knee and ankle; outside hand on the floor

criteria.label: Legs
criteria.text: Both legs fully extended in a split; inside foot touches the floor

criteria.label: Body
criteria.text: One-handed back bend

criteria.label: Split
criteria.text: At least 180°

criteria.label: Hold
criteria.text: At least 2 seconds

name: Upright Twisted Capezio
description: An upright oversplit. Your inside arm wraps around the pole and holds the foot of your back leg, which stretches over your head in a ring position. Your front leg stays fully extended against the pole, and your outside arm holds it.

criteria.label: Contact
criteria.text: Front thigh, side of torso, back of shoulder, top arm

criteria.label: Arms
criteria.text: Inside arm around the pole, holding the foot or ankle of the back leg. Outside arm holds the front leg

criteria.label: Legs
criteria.text: Oversplit. Front leg fully extended and touching the pole; back leg and foot stretched over the head in a ring position

criteria.label: Body
criteria.text: Upright

criteria.label: Split
criteria.text: At least 190°

criteria.label: Hold
criteria.text: At least 2 seconds

name: Floor Based Marchenko
description: An inverted handstand split that starts from the floor. Your inside arm presses into the floor in an underarm grip, your outside arm holds your inside leg, and your legs open into a full split with your chest facing down.

criteria.label: Grip
criteria.text: Underarm grip

criteria.label: Arms
criteria.text: Both arms fully extended; inside arm on the floor in underarm grip, outside arm holding the inside leg at the ankle or calf

criteria.label: Contact
criteria.text: Underarm of the inside arm, side of torso, back of one thigh

criteria.label: Legs
criteria.text: Both legs fully extended in a split of at least 180°

criteria.label: Body
criteria.text: Inverted handstand, chest facing down

criteria.label: Start
criteria.text: From the floor

criteria.label: Hold
criteria.text: At least 2 seconds

name: Elbow Grip Seat
description: A seated hold that starts your strength journey. Hold the pole in the crook of your inside elbow, hook your inside knee, sit on the backs of your thighs and stretch the outside leg out on the same side.

criteria.label: Grip
criteria.text: Inside arm in elbow grip; outside arm in a fixed position of your choice

criteria.label: Contact
criteria.text: Crook of the elbow of the inside arm, back of the knee of the inside leg, backs of the thighs, glutes

criteria.label: Legs
criteria.text: Inside leg hooked, outside leg fully extended, both legs on the same side of the pole

criteria.label: Hold
criteria.text: At least 2 seconds

name: Cupid
description: A hands-free hold with your body on a diagonal. Hook the pole behind your inside knee, press the sole of your outside foot against it, and open both arms away from the pole.

criteria.label: Arms
criteria.text: Both arms in a fixed position of your choice, no contact with the pole

criteria.label: Contact
criteria.text: Inside knee of the inside leg, foot of the outside leg

criteria.label: Legs
criteria.text: Inside leg hooked to the pole at the knee; outside leg fully extended with the sole of the foot on the pole

criteria.label: Body
criteria.text: Upright, diagonal to the pole

criteria.label: Hold
criteria.text: At least 2 seconds

name: Basic Superman
description: Fly flat beside the pole. Squeeze the pole between your inner thighs, hold it with one hand, and stretch your body, arms and closed legs out parallel to the floor.

criteria.label: Grip
criteria.text: Both arms fully extended, only one hand holds the pole

criteria.label: Contact
criteria.text: Both inner thighs, one hand

criteria.label: Legs
criteria.text: Both legs fully extended and closed

criteria.label: Body
criteria.text: Hips and legs parallel to the floor

criteria.label: Hold
criteria.text: At least 2 seconds

name: Russian Layback 1
description: An inverted layback held by your legs and both hands. Hook the pole in the crook of one knee, cross the other leg over it, face away from the pole and reach both straight arms down to hold it.

criteria.label: Grip
criteria.text: Basic grip

criteria.label: Arms
criteria.text: Both arms extended, holding the pole above your head (relative to you, upside down)

criteria.label: Contact
criteria.text: Hands, crook of the knee and back of the thigh, glutes. Optional: ankle or calf

criteria.label: Legs
criteria.text: One leg grips the pole in the crook of the knee and along the back of the thigh, the other leg crosses over it

criteria.label: Body
criteria.text: Inverted, facing away from the pole

criteria.label: Hold
criteria.text: At least 2 seconds

name: Butterfly Reverse Extension
description: An inverted split held by straight arms. Your top hand cups the pole, the heel of the opposite leg presses against it to twist your hips, and both legs open wide.

criteria.label: Grip
criteria.text: Top hand in cup grip

criteria.label: Arms
criteria.text: Both arms fully extended

criteria.label: Contact
criteria.text: Both hands and one heel

criteria.label: Legs
criteria.text: Both legs fully extended in a split

criteria.label: Body
criteria.text: Inverted; the heel of the leg opposite the top hand is on the pole, twisting the hips

criteria.label: Hold
criteria.text: At least 2 seconds

name: Iron X 1
description: A pure strength hold on two straight arms. Your upper body sticks out sideways from the pole, close to a right angle, while your legs open in an even straddle.

criteria.label: Grip
criteria.text: Grip of your choice, except cup grip

criteria.label: Arms
criteria.text: Both arms fully extended

criteria.label: Contact
criteria.text: Both hands

criteria.label: Legs
criteria.text: Both legs fully extended in an even straddle, hips bent forwards

criteria.label: Body
criteria.text: Upper body at 90° to the pole (20° tolerance), facing the same direction

criteria.label: Hold
criteria.text: At least 2 seconds

name: Shoulder Mount Plank 1
description: A plank held from a shoulder mount. Starting from an aerial shoulder mount pencil (S29), you lower your whole body until it is straight and parallel to the floor.

criteria.label: Grip
criteria.text: Cup grip or basic grip

criteria.label: Arms
criteria.text: Both arms bent

criteria.label: Contact
criteria.text: Both hands and one shoulder (neck optional)

criteria.label: Legs
criteria.text: Both legs fully extended and closed, parallel to the floor

criteria.label: Body
criteria.text: Back and legs at 90° to the pole

criteria.label: Start
criteria.text: From an aerial shoulder mount pencil position (S29), lower into the plank

criteria.label: Hold
criteria.text: At least 2 seconds

name: Iguana Horizontal
description: A horizontal hold in the iguana position. Your top arm reaches behind your back to hold the pole, and your whole body stays straight and parallel to the floor.

criteria.label: Grip
criteria.text: Basic grip

criteria.label: Arms
criteria.text: Bottom arm may be bent; top arm fully extended, holding the pole behind your back in the iguana position

criteria.label: Contact
criteria.text: Both hands and one shoulder (neck optional)

criteria.label: Legs
criteria.text: Both legs fully extended and closed, parallel to the floor

criteria.label: Body
criteria.text: Entire body at 90° to the pole

criteria.label: Start
criteria.text: From an aerial position, deadlift or lower into a 90° horizontal angle to the pole, parallel to the floor

criteria.label: Hold
criteria.text: At least 2 seconds in the final position

name: Back Hook Twist Spin
description: A spin hooked by the crook of one knee. Your outside arm stays straight and holds the pole behind your body.

criteria.label: Contact
criteria.text: Crook of one knee, opposite hand

criteria.label: Arms
criteria.text: Outside arm extended, holding the pole behind the body

criteria.label: Hold
criteria.text: At least 720° of rotation

name: Twisted Spin
description: An upright spin with no hands on the pole. One leg stretches along the pole, the other bends around it, and your body and the spinning pole carry you round at least two full turns.

criteria.label: Contact
criteria.text: Full length of one leg; calf, thigh and crook of the knee of the other leg; hips, side of torso, back. Optional: neck

criteria.label: Arms
criteria.text: Fixed position of your choice, no hand contact with the pole

criteria.label: Legs
criteria.text: One leg fully extended alongside the pole, the other bent around the pole

criteria.label: Body
criteria.text: Upright; your head is on the same side of the pole as the foot of the bent leg

criteria.label: Hold
criteria.text: At least 720° of rotation

name: Underarm Hold Spin
description: An upright spin held by your underarm instead of your hands. Hook the pole in the crook of your inside arm, stretch one leg along the pole, bend the other knee, and let the pole turn you round at least twice.

criteria.label: Grip
criteria.text: Underarm grip

criteria.label: Contact
criteria.text: Inside underarm, inner upper thigh, inside knee, outside foot. Optional: shin or calf of the outside leg

criteria.label: Arms
criteria.text: Fixed position of your choice, no hand contact with the pole. Only the inside arm touches the pole

criteria.label: Legs
criteria.text: One leg fully extended along the pole, the other knee bent

criteria.label: Body
criteria.text: Upright

criteria.label: Hold
criteria.text: At least 720° of rotation

name: Carousel Spin Elbow Grip
description: An upright spin hanging from your elbow. Your upper elbow hooks the pole, your bottom arm stays straight against it, and your legs form a diamond as you turn.

criteria.label: Grip
criteria.text: Elbow grip

criteria.label: Arms
criteria.text: Upper elbow holds the pole; bottom arm fully extended and touching the pole

criteria.label: Contact
criteria.text: One elbow and one hand

criteria.label: Legs
criteria.text: Diamond

criteria.label: Body
criteria.text: Upright

criteria.label: Rotation
criteria.text: At least 720°

name: Meathook Pike Spin
description: An inverted spin wrapped around the pole. Your inside arm holds on fully extended while your closed, straight legs fold into a pike and your free arm reaches out.

criteria.label: Arms
criteria.text: Inside arm fully extended and holding the pole; outside arm in a fixed position of your choice, not touching the pole

criteria.label: Contact
criteria.text: One hand and arm, thighs, hips, torso. Optional: shoulder

criteria.label: Legs
criteria.text: Both legs fully extended and closed in a pike

criteria.label: Body
criteria.text: Wrapped around the pole

criteria.label: Rotation
criteria.text: At least 720°

name: Gargoyle Spin No Hands
description: A hands-free spin held only by your bent legs. You face the floor with your upper body horizontal, and both arms stretch out without touching the pole or your body.

criteria.label: Arms
criteria.text: Both arms fully extended, not touching the pole or your body

criteria.label: Contact
criteria.text: Calves, crook of the knees, back of the thighs

criteria.label: Legs
criteria.text: Both legs bent

criteria.label: Body
criteria.text: Facing down, upper body horizontal

criteria.label: Rotation
criteria.text: At least 720°

name: Titanic Support
description: An upright spin with no hands. You hold the pole with your legs and glutes, arch your upper body back and stretch both arms behind you as you turn.

criteria.label: Arms
criteria.text: Both arms fully extended back, not touching the pole

criteria.label: Contact
criteria.text: One leg, thigh of the other leg, glutes. Optional: one shoulder or side of the neck, foot

criteria.label: Legs
criteria.text: Both legs fully extended

criteria.label: Body
criteria.text: Upright, upper body in a back arch

criteria.label: Rotation
criteria.text: At least 720°

name: Supported Sailor
description: An inverted, fully extended spin. Your closed, straight legs lock onto the pole at the ankles and shin, your inside arm presses against the pole and your outside arm reaches out.

criteria.label: Arms
criteria.text: Inside arm fully extended and touching the pole; outside arm in a fixed position of your choice, not touching the pole

criteria.label: Contact
criteria.text: Both ankles, one shin and one calf, one hand. Optional: one foot

criteria.label: Legs
criteria.text: Fully extended and closed

criteria.label: Body
criteria.text: Inverted and extended

criteria.label: Rotation
criteria.text: At least 720°
